description:
The Singletrailer II Gravel 20" is the premium choice for active families, designed as a high-performance bicycle child trailer with adjustable suspension. Whether you are commuting in traffic or exploring gravel paths, this trailer offers uncompromised safety and comfort for your child.
Key features for family adventures

Single-wheel agility: The unique single-wheel design and machined alloy drawbar with sealed bearings ensure a stable, vibration-free connection that follows your bike precisely, even on rough terrain.

Maximum comfort: A lightweight steel frame and adjustable suspension dampen bumps, and the comfortable cabin has an adjustable, weatherproof ripstop cover.

Touring ready: Rolls on a classic 20" wheel with a large-volume tire for smooth handling.

Smart storage: A fold-out rear pocket carries all your touring essentials.

Age and capacity: Safe and supportive for children aged 3 months to 5 years, up to 25 kg (55 lb), with customizable accessory options.
